value.signature: fn encode_paper_boundary (value : & PaperCaseBoundary , limits : & ReadAllowances) -> Result < Vec < u8 > , FragmentError >

review.body: { let encoded = encoded (& paper_boundary_value (value) , limits) ? ; parse_paper_boundary (& Value :: from_canonical_bytes (& encoded) . map_err (| _ | FragmentError :: Canonical) ? , limits ,) ? ; Ok (encoded) }
review.item_premise: Caller-selected fragment codecs read complete public component bytes under supplied limits and return bounded public refusals. They neither select an evaluator nor establish publication binding.
